description: The director-mode bundle manifest (mode.toml, spec-20260905-063000 D1): ONE unit binding the agent card, the gate pack, the declared role cards, the protocol skills, the received handoff seed, the schema version, and the per-consumer minimum-version map. Declared-set rule: a bundle ships fewer roles/skills only by explicit declaration here; a declared component that does not resolve fails validation in BOTH the vitest suite and the doctor probe (one shared validator).

agent.description: The agent id that BINDS this mode (spec D4 posture-binding map, #808): a session resolved to this agent id runs this mode's director posture; every agent id outside the declared set binds the copilot posture and is silent. The plugin's posture map reads THIS field — never a mode-name branch.

card.description: The bundle's agent card file, byte-identical to the legacy agents/ card it mirrors until slice 2 (D3) flips the source.

consumer_floors.description: Per-consumer minimum-version map — one floor cannot govern four consumer kinds. A consumer below its floor fails loudly; a plugin-side gap renders the explicit unresolvable block, never silence.

handoff_seeds.description: The handoff seeds this mode RECEIVES (D6). kind → receiving mode is registry data; the registry-level validator checks every pack handoff targeting this mode emits the kind declared here.

schema.description: Path (relative to the bundle dir) of the seed's committed JSON Schema.

mode.description: The mode's slug; the bundle directory must be named the same.

pack.description: The mode's gate pack — schema'd, descriptive data (runtime reads expected; cast-time enforcement is out of scope).

protocol_skills.description: The mode's protocol skill names (the binding surface).

roles.description: Declared roles — every role the pack casts, each naming its card file. A declared role that does not resolve under the extension root fails validation.

path.description: Path (relative to the bundle dir) of the role card. Must resolve under the extension root.

title: mode bundle manifest (mode.toml)
